scope: P0 of the constitutional role-separation audit: independent verification required before work counts as done.
verified_by: node --test (deterministic) + git blob comparison + Chair ruling c646160f-128a-4b43-9884-af37cd5a868a
separation_note: One actor (cursor-agent) designed the gates AND authored the tests that prove them, so the verifier is not independent of the producer in the strict sense. Declared rather than hidden, per docs/products/builderos/PRODUCT_HOME.md Separation Of Duties. Partial independence does exist and is named: the Chair (separate model, judgment_degraded=false, strong tier) ruled on blocking posture and scope before implementation, git supplied the byte comparisons rather than any self-report, and every assertion is a deterministic substring/existence check that no model can reason its way past. The residual risk is a blind spot shared between gate and test - an independent actor re-deriving the falsification cases from the doctrine alone would close it. This receipt is the first in the repository to make this declaration, which is itself a finding: the requirement has existed in doctrine and 128 of 128 receipts had ignored it.

bp_sync.why: This is an internal governance proof, not an active product queue item, so it carries no founder packet. Registered rather than downgraded: dropping the verdict below PASS to slip past the orphan-PASS guard would be gaming the check this work exists to strengthen.

chair_ruling.posture: Hard-block ONLY for the irreversible / high-blast-radius set (auth, secrets, money). Detect-and-route for everything else so the autonomous loop is never idled (SO-003).
chair_ruling.scope: All three P0 items: ship-path gates, migration verification, receipt validation coverage. Hold P1 until data pulls it.
chair_ruling.conservation_law: A machine-path gate running the same checks as the hook SUBSUMES the hook for that path rather than accreting a new tier.

headline_finding: githooks/pre-commit was the ONLY caller of scripts/security-invariants-check.mjs, and a GitHub API commit cannot run a local hook. The standing orders mandate shipping via execute-batch -> commitToGitHub, so the single gate protecting tenant isolation did not cover the only path agents are allowed to use. routes/tc-routes.js lost requireLifeOSAdmin on all 121 routes twice on 2026-07-27 and reached production both times. CI does not backstop it either: .github/workflows/railway-deploy.yml is workflow_dispatch only, and the real deploy is build-from-latest, so no workflow gates an automatic deploy.

changes.design: One checker, two callers. The invariant list and evaluation moved into a pure lib that judges PROPOSED bytes, so it works before a file exists on disk. The hook is now a thin CLI over it (and reads the STAGED blob rather than the worktree, which is what a pre-commit gate should judge). The gate is installed in commitOrMirrorFiles - the single choke point all three commit sites funnel through - so no future route can route around it.
changes.proven: Refuses an auth-stripping batch with HTTP 422 and commitManyToGitHub is never reached; lets a clean file and an intact protected file through; blocked a real staged regression end-to-end with the protected file restored byte-identical (sha e963484c165c696f0f43396ddcaa44ac0dc9e6f48591591ef7c426de1488687a before and after).

changes.item: P0-2 migrations must prove their end state
changes.design: Opt-in `-- @assert table:/column:/index:` directives checked by read-only SELECT 1 after apply; a migration whose declared objects are absent is NOT marked applied so it retries. The /already exists/ forgiveness is now conditional on the declared end state existing, closing the case where a multi-statement file rolls back whole yet is recorded applied forever. schema_migrations.checksum gives a migration an identity beyond its filename so editing an applied file is detectable. The two incompatible schema_migrations declarations were converged.
changes.posture: detect-and-route (boot is never blocked - refusing to boot is more destructive than the drift)
changes.proven: 14 tests including both falsifiability directions. 0 of 401 existing migrations declare an assertion, so current behaviour is unchanged by construction.

changes.item: P0-3 receipt validation coverage and verifier identity
changes.design: Validation scope was chosen BY FILENAME, so a producer could opt its own claim out of review by naming the file something the hint list did not match - 96 of 128 receipts were never checked, 14 of them asserting PASS, including the SO-002 SENTRY Layer A gate receipt itself. Scope is now every receipt except the validator's own report (which it was previously grading). PASS claims must name produced_by and verified_by, or declare separation_collapsed with a real reason. Legacy receipts are grandfathered by date/schema so the rule cannot red-light builder:preflight.
changes.posture: detect-and-route, with a shrinking baseline for pre-existing debt
changes.proven: Immediately caught two PASS claims with no commit evidence that filenames had been hiding, plus five PASS claims with no named verifier - including this agent's own deploy-truth receipts. Five were fixed at the producer; two are baselined with named fixes.

not_proven: The ship-path gate has not yet refused a real regression in PRODUCTION - only locally and in tests. Runtime proof requires the deployed build, and safely probing it would mean POSTing an auth-stripped tc-routes.js to the live builder, which is exactly the harm the gate exists to prevent. Deliberately not attempted; the gate's production behaviour is THINK, not KNOW, until it fires on its own.
Migration assertion and checksum paths have not executed against the production database, only against a stub pool. First real exercise is the next boot after deploy.

config/receipt-truth-baseline.json holds 2 admitted violations. SITE_BUILDER_PREALPHA_LAYER_A.json is the SO-002 gate receipt asserting PASS with no commit_sha and no production_base, so there is currently no evidence identifying which build passed that gate.
deliberately_not_built: scripts/ssot-check.js and the file-synopsis law are still hook-only and therefore still bypassed on every machine ship. They are NOT the irreversible class, so copying the hard-block pattern would violate the Gate Charter; they need detect-and-route instead. Filed as Q-003 rather than built, per the Chair's warning against speculative governance accretion.
